description: Read your private plan, protected booked tickets, requests and as-planned capacity. Every film and plan names both ids: filmId (the planner's own) and amcMovieId (the filmId list_releases gives; null for a film without an AMC match). Pass filmId, the filmId from list_releases or the planner's own, to list only that film in films, plans, tickets, bookingRequests and suggestions. Never creates booking intent.

filmId.description: Use the filmId from list_releases (the AMC movie id); the planner's own film id from get_plan works too.

name: get_plan
title: Get your movie plan
